text:
Claire: Hey team — Horizon Health wants into the sneak-peek next week. They have two engineering seats and want help with SSO + data retention policy. Can we take them?
Jonah: Sounds good. What's their target date? Who can own the SSO walkthrough?
Claire: They asked for Wed 10-11 PT. I can lead the SSO walkthrough but need a short runbook + slides. @rishi can you share the trimmed SSO runbook we use for pilots?
Rishi: Yep — I have a slimmed runbook and a checklist. Pushing link: https://redwood.internal/ssorunbooks/horizon (will paste to #eng-ops too). I can demo the SSO flow in the kickoff.
Linh: I'll take the data retention doc. Draft by EOD tomorrow, will include sample retention defaults and KMS notes.
Emily: Noted renewal risk — they mentioned a potential budget freeze next quarter. We should lock clear success criteria during kickoff: 1) p95 latency <250ms, 2) monthly cost < target, 3) SSO success rate > 95%.
Claire: Agree. Also want a micro-survey 1 week after onboarding to capture initial sentiment. @jonah can you make a 3-question survey using the pilot-feedback template?
Jonah: Draft Qs in thread: 1) Did the integration match expectations? (Y/N) 2) Any major blockers (tech/ops/permissions)? 3) How likely to convert (1-5)? Posting draft link: https://forms.redwood/pilot-feedback/xyz — please review :eyes: 
Rishi: Suggest we offer prefix caching opt-in on day 1 to show cost delta. I can prepare a short demo and a config cheat-sheet.
Linh: Small wording tweak to Q2 done — now: "Blockers encountered (tech / ops / permissions)".
Claire: Asha (Horizon) confirmed Wed 10-11 PT. I'll send calendar invite with preread: SSO runbook + retention doc + Jonah's survey link.
calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled Wed 10-11 PT with Asha (Horizon) :calendar:
Jonah: Survey link posted and shared in invite. If nobody objects I'll finalize by EOD.
Emily: For the renewal flag, I'll add a short mitigation plan in CRM: weekly check-ins for 3 weeks, demo of cache savings, and cost estimate after week 1.
Rishi: I'll prepare a tiny demo snippet for kickoff to show savings, e.g. `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/demo -d '{"prompt":"cache test"}'` — will include before/after token counts.
Claire: That covers it. Owners: Claire (kickoff + invite), Rishi (SSO + demo), Linh (retention doc), Jonah (survey), Emily (renewal mitigation + CRM). I'll run weekly syncs for first 3 weeks and share notes in #customer-success. :thumbsup:
Jonah: Thanks — leaving the draft survey in drive, will update if any edits.
Linh: Will send retention doc PR by EOD.
Emily: I'll flag a success metric card in the pilot board.
Claire: Closing loop — will post meeting notes after kickoff and attach action items.
